title: Settings
description: Language, appearance, wallet, and the data on this phone.
walletClosed: No wallet is open in this browser yet.
installBody: Add it to your home screen so it opens as an app. Your profile stays on this phone.
installShare: Once it is installed on Android, select M-Pesa texts in your SMS app and tap Share, then PesaSense. On iPhone, paste the messages or use the statement PDF.
installInstalled: PesaSense is installed on this device.
installIos: In Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
installMenu: Open the browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home Screen.
installOffline: Connect to the internet before installing.
